rationale: Stops a React commit that changed only provably non-geometric props from forcing a full re-apply of the captured import document. Touching render-assets-and-backends is packages/pulp-react only: commitUpdate consults a hand-curated PAINT_ONLY_KEYS whitelist before calling markMaterializedTreeDirty, and any key not on that whitelist -- including every unrecognised key -- still takes the existing full-re-apply path, so behaviour is byte-identical for every commit the gate does not recognise. The whitelist deliberately excludes border, borderWidth and the side width shorthands even though prop-applier-paint.ts owns them, because they carry a width; it also excludes opacity and color because the captured-metadata pass writes setOpacity and setTextColor itself, and suppressing those commits would leave React's value standing until a later structural commit restored the captured one. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no harness, fixture, snapshot or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
